title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
Junior Data Scientist

6-Month contract - Inside IR35 - up to £360 per day

Slough based - hybrid working - 2-3 days a week onsite

Telecoms sector


The role

This is a hands-on position where you will need to use your analytical skills to find solutions to business problems and improve our customers' experience. This could include personalised communications for customers, improving our stock management models, better marketing effectiveness, maximising customer lifetime value and reducing customer churn.


On any day, depending on your expertise and your learning objectives, you could be building models in the cloud for automation of decision-making across the business or optimising processes for key business objectives; defining project expectations with internal or external stakeholders; or conducting deep-dive exploratory analysis to inform strategic decision-making. Throughout your work you would keep our customers as the focus of all analysis.


Key Responsibilities

- Responsible for building, validating, optimising and managing basic models and data pipelines

- Responsible for relevant parts of the data science lifecycle including documentation and security considerations

- Analysis of diverse data using statistical methods to make recommendations to improve customer experience and business results

- Identify improvements in own work and develop own skills

- Good understanding and use of our internal dataset

- Working collaboratively within data science team and project group to knowledge share and get the best possible outcome


Skills & Experience

- Intermediate SQL, Python, and scikit-learn and basic PySpark coding skills with a good understanding of standard coding practices.

- Database experience

- Code optimisation and standard software development skills such as writing tests for code

- Knowledge of the full ML lifecycle, experience in deployment beneficial

- Ability to reframe ambiguous business questions with help into solvable form.

- Can clearly articulate ideas with non-technical language and tell a simple story to non technical audience

- Demonstrate good listening skills to understand the needs of my stakeholders and customers.

- Can independently and constructively review others' work and can challenge decisions in a positive way

- Knowledge of methodologies/tools for data validation, model versioning and model performance monitoring
